annotations.title: Look up a person or character on Rightis

description: Check whether a person or character is registered with Rightis by rights_id (BR-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) and which AI uses they allow, require approval for, or refuse. do_not_train=true means their data must not be used for training. Call this before generating a likeness, voice or persona of a real person.
